details.further_information: Berke Özer transferred to Lille OSC for €4.5 million. His transfer fee could rise to €500,000 with bonuses. Fenerbahçe was initially going to receive 40% of the transfer fee, but they waived this option and will now receive 20% of the transfer fee from Lille OSC on Berke's next sale. Portimonense received 20% of the transfer fee (€900,000) in the subsequent sale.
